title: WhatToLookAt: learned relations become a sensing budget
summary: WhatToLookAt takes the history-written relation machinery from SighImageFactorization and asks a compressed-sensing-style engineering question: if experience has already learned useful structure, how many future physical observations can be omitted? Gates 0–2 establish the relation-to-budget mechanism, Gate 3 derives local confidence from a charged low-resolution image channel, and Gate 4 weakens exact relation equality into a falsifiable compression hypothesis audited by a cheap current residual. The branch keeps the Sigh/Sihti operator framing but changes the currency from segmentation or relation authority to the minimum measurement cost required to maintain reconstruction quality.

nodes.claim: Learns persistent relations from past temporal structure and uses them as a prior for future sparse sensing; local relation uncertainty withdraws sharing authority and purchases extra measurements only where confidence is low.
nodes.survived: A correct relation partition can replace measurements; common-fate history can learn that partition before a rearranged future is undersampled; image-derived match confidence localizes where expensive sensing is needed; and a cheap residual projection can audit when an approximate relation has stopped predicting high-resolution content, keeping the adaptive cost curve close to an oracle residual policy.
nodes.killed: Spatial, shuffled-relation, time-shuffled-history and coordinate-memory controls do not recover the same savings; blind trust collapses under wrong correspondence; matched-cost shuffled confidence fails; fixed one-per-relation sensing collapses under local content innovation; and equal-cost random extra reads do not substitute for residual-localized sensing.

edges.why: WhatToLookAt explicitly states that it pushes the compressed-sensing question into the SighImageFactorization/Sihti lineage and operationalizes SighImageFactorization's learned relation state as a prior that can reduce future sensing.

WhatToLookAt explicitly names Sihti in its lineage and carries forward the operator-dependent-structure framing, but does not claim Sihti code inheritance; the new currency is measurement cost rather than residue location.
